name: Donga Door BAL29
subtitle: BAL29 ready insulated steel doorset for transportable and modular buildings.
shortDescription: Australian engineered pre-hung insulated steel doorset designed for transportable buildings, modular accommodation and remote site applications. BAL29 ready, wind load tested and built for demanding Australian conditions.
longDescription: The Motisan Donga Door BAL29 is a pre-hung insulated steel doorset engineered for transportable buildings, modular accommodation and remote site applications across Australia. Featuring a dual-frame system, galvanised steel construction and Rockwool insulated core, it delivers reliable durability, thermal performance and security in harsh environments. The doorset has been wind load tested in accordance with Section 7 of AS/NZS 4420.1:2016 and is suitable for BAL29 applications in accordance with AS 3959 requirements.

features.explain: Designed for BAL-rated applications and assessed against AS 3959 construction requirements for BAL12.5, BAL19 and BAL29.
Tested to relevant Australian wind loading requirements in accordance with Section 7 of AS/NZS 4420.1:2016.
Pre-hung dual-frame system simplifies installation and is ideal for modular and transportable buildings.
Manufactured using galvanised steel door leaf and frame with UV-resistant powder coating for long-term durability.
Rockwool mineral wool insulated core improves thermal efficiency and acoustic performance.
Equipped with heavy-duty stainless steel hinges and commercial locking systems for reliable operation.

specifications.Fire Assessment: CSIRO advisory assessment for BAL12.5, BAL19 & BAL29 applications

whyChoose: The Motisan Donga Door BAL29 is purpose-built for Australian transportable and modular construction projects where bushfire compliance, wind resistance and long-term durability are essential. Combining BAL29 readiness, wind load tested performance, a pre-hung dual-frame system and Rockwool insulated steel construction, it delivers a dependable solution for remote and high-wind environments.
